integration_notes: Add pub mod blast_prelim_evaluate. No shared files edited by this worker.

s_blast_search_engine_core(program,frame_lengths,original_subject_length,subject_oid,query_info,score_params,hit_params,&mut ScoreBlk,optional GappedStats,callback(index)->Result<Option<Box<HSPList>>,i16>,&mut output)->i16. Callback returns raw BLAST_GetGappedScore result for that complete context before endpoint purge/Evalues. For ordinary blastn frame_lengths=&[subject_length], one callback. For tblastn original length is nucleotide length, frame_lengths are AA lengths and callbacks carry original subject.frame values.

Stats/Evalue phase requires mutable ScoreBlk; preliminary callback may be precomputed before taking that borrow. Both nucleotide_search and protein_search workers have the exact API and source call-order constraints. Collector owns dynamic low_score feedback; this closure never changes it.

Default gapped preliminary path intentionally does not run ambiguity reevaluation, identity/query-coverage filtering or bit scores. In source those engine-level operations belong to the separate ungapped branch; gapped search performs them at traceback. Odd score adjustment at this preliminary location is disabled by original #if0.

Blast_HSPListAppend and s_BlastHSPListsCombineByScore provide exact score-ranked frame accumulation; existing blast_hits storage helpers are reused. No generic Vec concatenation or Evalue-ranked merge substitutes for them.
